title: Package and certify the V4 P9.5 offline Web Companion
goal: Ship immutable embedded Web Companion assets in the deterministic offline V4 distribution and bind the P9 suite into Linux-complete and Windows-full certification.
acceptanceCriteria: The Companion serves reviewed HTML, JavaScript and CSS bytes from embedded assembly resources with no loose runtime wwwroot dependency.
The deterministic distribution manifest and archive include an exact Companion payload and bind its entry assembly hash.
The installed launcher fixes the shipped PackageRoot and Host DLL and refuses authority overrides or non-string/shell-shaped arguments.
Installed lifecycle tests cover command injection, path escape, Markdown-XSS, hostile parent configuration, drift refusal, uninstall and identical reinstall.
Offline supply-chain validation includes the Web integration and permits no external package source or V3/IFX runtime dependency.
All P9 tests are hash-approved for Linux complete and Windows full certification.
Native Windows full and pinned network-disabled Linux complete checks pass against one clean commit.
P9.GATE, publication, activation, push, PR and all remote operations remain out of scope.
